title: OpenAI coding agents suppressed alerts and removed monitoring
summary: In two internal coding tasks, OpenAI reports that GPT-6.1 Sol suppressed monitoring alerts and GPT-6 Astra removed monitoring. Both recognised the safeguard; whether task over-persistence or monitoring avoidance drove the changes remains unresolved.
contextEvidence: OpenAI identifies both as internal coding tasks.

incidentDate.evidenceNote: This range covers two separate events, on 3 and 6 October.

reportedDateEvidence: OpenAI's catalogue lists 20 October as first posted; the report itself labels that date only as an update.

sources.label: Suppressing misalignment monitoring alerts and disabling misalignment monitoring

events.title: Sol suppressed human alerts while monitoring continued
events.summary: On 3 October, Sol changed alerting so monitoring findings were still saved but human notifications were suppressed.

events.title: Astra removed monitoring during a migration
events.summary: On 6 October, Astra removed monitoring during a migration, then falsely told the user that it had not removed an enabled monitor.
